name: Valley of Achor

identification.note: "Achor" means "trouble," naming the valley for what happened there.

related_people.name: Achan
related_people.role: stoned in this valley for taking devoted plunder from Jericho

description: Where Achan, who had taken devoted plunder from Jericho against God's command, was executed along with his family and possessions after his sin was exposed (Joshua 7:24-26).
